This place... looks like a laboratory.
这里……像是实验室。

Evaluation Arena 1F - Lab Ruins
评审场1层 实验室废墟

There's nothing left. Not even a faint blood fragrance.
什么都不剩了。哪怕是一丝血腥味。

Though I sense a scurrying rat.
不过倒是有藏着的老鼠。

A rat...?
老鼠……？

dataList.content:
Know who you're talking to before you insult them. Who are you?
管好你的嘴。你们是谁？
dataList.title:

dataList.content:
W-we're a different candidate's clan.
我……我们是其他的候选人。

Hi, I'm Baoyu of the Jia family.
您好，我是贾家宝玉。

Hong Lu extended a placid greeting.
鸿璐泰然自若地打了招呼。
I thought you had twelve companions, Jia Baoyu... so what's this Wang guy doing here? You've already made an alliance? A thing like you? 贾宝玉……听说你带了十二个人，怎么还有姓王的家伙？你，这么快就结盟了？区区一个贾宝玉？
dataList.title:
???
？？？

dataList.content:
Aha, but we're not allies.
啊哈，我们并没有结盟。

Doesn't seem like he's buying it. Doubt he ever will.
不管说什么对面都不会信的吧。

So who is he, Hong Lu?
那位是谁啊，鸿璐先生？

He's uh... He's... I'm pretty sure he's from the Shi family... So he must be Shi...
嗯，他是……史家的……史……

Shi...
史……

There was an awkward silence.
陷入了片刻沉默。

Ahem... Hua... c'mon, man. Hua...
咳哼……华……华……！

Ah, thanks for the help~ So he's Shi... Hua... something...
啊，谢谢您~史……华……

Good, you're getting there. You're getting warmer. Now, let's—
对对，就在嘴边了。后面是……

What the hell are you guys doing?
你们在干嘛？

Forget it, who gives a shit anyway.
妈的。无所谓了。

If every candidate indeed has the same number of coins... I should prioritize finding weaker candidates like you to steal from.
如果所有参与者都拥有相同数量的铜钱……那就要快点抢走你这种家伙的铜钱，才能占到更高的排名。

It's beyond me where you even got the guts to throw your hat in the ring for the Family Hierarch war outta nowhere.
真不知道你哪来的胆子，莫名其妙就来参加家主之争。

Last I heard, you were roaming the City like some unemployed lout after spending years holed up in Daguanyuan. So what brings you here, huh? Had enough of the City tour?
听说一直窝在大观园的你去外面逛了逛。转悠半天，你还是觉得太无聊了吗？

Luckily, I never had a moment of boredom. I found so many marvelous and interesting things out there.
所幸，连无聊的空隙都没有。外面充满了新奇的事物。

Like, did you know that there are people out there who sleep in roofless rooms?
你知道吗，这世界上还有人在没有屋顶的房间里安睡呢？

Asshole, think you're funny...?! I swear, I'm gonna eliminate you here...!
你敢耍我……！我一定要淘汰掉你……

You sure know how to make friends, young master Baoyu.
人气可真旺啊，贾宝玉少爷。
